areas.name: The Belly of the Beast Level 1
The Belly of the Beast Level 2

cards.f:
All things slow under winter's
onslaught - even life itself.
The Poet's blood is the Empire's ink.
In the oldest halls of my mind, at the end of a rarely used passage, lies my greatest treasure: one moment of happiness and innocence, pure and untouchable.

The mighty huntress always called for her share,
But what we shared was a lifelong bond.
"It was as though my very thoughts were breaking... fracturing into tiny motes to be lost on the wind."

Cede all power and wealth to me and serve me in perpetuity.
A minor inconvenience I assure you.

Nature was her domain,
Love was her song,
Family was her devotion,
Knowledge was her gift.

The artist is long dead,
the lyrics are long forgotten,
yet the Song of War longs to be sung again
The harvest ended, the floods began.
They gave the stone life. Over eons spent bathed in Corruption, that life evolved.
When the world burned, the greedy burned with it, while the clever left as paupers.

The world is ever-changing.
Once-lush woods now lost beneath shifting sands,
Great cities now drown beneath turbulent waters.
Adapt or perish.

The hatungo know many answers to the same question,
for time itself is a tangled web.
Her innocence and grace were enough to tame even the wildest of beasts.

A treasure worth killing for
is a treasure worth dying for.

"Sometimes, the most beautiful treasures...are the ones you cannot have."
- Beryl, Survivor from the Azurite Mines
You mustn't forget: you won't be leaving this place.
The most pathetic person in the world is someone who has sight, but no vision.
Born of relentless fury and abhorrence, warped by turmoil and anguish, tainted through desire and carnality, I thirst for bloodshed once more.

The Ezomytes,
buried beneath flaming mountains
by the First Ones.
The Vaal,
undone by a cataclysm
of their own making.
Are all empires fated to fall to hubris?
Discovery can lead to beauty, or it can lead to ruin.

By the time their eyes meet,
the dark deal has long since been made,
and his fate long since sealed.

What matters are
the Marks of your life,
not its Longevity.

For a time, we had something stronger than eldritch evil.
We had each other.
In the prison of all sins, will you grasp godhood or sorrow? Only hope lies under the shadows.

A jolt, and it moves. Or smolders.
A current, and it lives. Or dies.
A surge, and it transcends.
Or... not.
Only one way to find out.

"Gaze upon the mirrors of what may come and step backward into infinity."
- Dexion, Thaumetic Aspirant

Blazing through the night
Longing for infinite flight
Awaiting dawn's first light

The mask hides his identity
but also makes it hard to read...

Method transcends shape and size. Do something in parallel long enough, and you will always find
another way.
The line between having not enough to do and too much to do is unusually fine.

Her beauty did not fade
her humanity did not survive.
"Such fine trinkets show their true value in times of crisis." - Tangmazu
A small token of Her affliction.
When the darkness weighs upon you, grow light from within.

"It's risky not knowing where your wares come from. That's why I source my own."
- Klayver, the Antiquarian
Some gifts are obligations while others are simply opportunities.

Wreathed in the skin and bones
of the beasts she slew,
her gift came from what she lost:
her humanity.

In battle we burn together
or not at all.
Boundless is the distance between where we start and where we start again.
If this is my dream, I don't wish to wake.
Experience teaches us that the cold is not the same as the absence of warmth.
With a single act, years of peace have been shattered. An unknown assassin brings war upon us all.

Even though his flame has burned out,
he will never fade away.

Even though he found the stash just in time,
He would trade it all away and then some to have him back.

Seeking shelter from the night,
in the warmth of the run-down inn,
erstwhile foes put aside the fight,
to bond over whiskey and gin.
"Man may shape the world, but these? These shape the man." -Inquisitor Maligaro
You can't seek riches without getting your hands dirty.

There's a place where up is down,
where right is wrong,
where pleasure is agony,
and where the living wish only for death.
The Ezomyte, desperate for aid, cried out to the gods.

"There are two ways to pay, Gold and Blood. I'll take my share in both."
-Cameria the Coldblooded

A map is similar
to a pair of eyes,
without one you stumble
around, unable to find your way.
Life isn't what you make of it, it's already been made for you.
A fond memory fills me with nostalgia; some men would have felt guilt, but I felt no regret over the anguish and fear my ambitions caused.
When victory is impossible, each of us plays only to delay the end.
As death approached, clarity eluded him. The pain he had wrought surrounded him, dragging him into darkness.
"Oh no, I couldn't possibly afford this fine artefact. I'm... just looking."

A King Loved By All,
A Shadow Awaiting Nightfall,
A Speaker Howling Away,
A Hunter Seeking Prey
A taste of power brings a hunger for more.
If you look hard enough for hidden meaning, you will find it.

Blood and death lead
the way to hell.
No one ever truly understood what she meant when she said she wanted to raise a family.

"Only a fool looks to the occult for power and expects to be spared from its wrath."
- Voll, Emperor of Purity
When you find what you're looking for, it's never quite right. When you have what you desire, yet you still want more.

"Be fast. That is all that matters."
- Rita of the Asylum

The end of the old,
the beginning of the new.
A unique opportunity for transformation,
for those with the power
to grasp it.
"The Karui was correct; there is virtue in honouring my ancestors."

I never truly understood the depths of my insanity,
until I realized the voices beckoning me towards the abyss,
were none other than my own.
Sometimes you need to make your own luck.

Awoken virtuous slivers of the void,
defiled by the avaricious,
seized by the tyrannical.
Through despondent hardships, those strong of spirit shall claim the prize.

"Let us not forget the most important lesson the Vaal taught us:
Nothing is eternal."
- Siosa Foaga, Imperial Scholar

A symbol of beauty and innocence
The gems corrupted her mind
Malachai corrupted her gems
All but a glimmer of
greatness lost in madness
No man sees all, but you'll see more than some see in a lifetime.

In a land far away lived
a maiden most fair.
Her smile melted the coldest
of hearts, her song made
men and beast cry,
her beauty unparalleled;
Divine.
Many sought the Goddess' blessing. Few survived the Labyrinth to receive it.

Sin sought to contain Divinity
so that no mortal would gain
such monstrous power ever again.
"Hold your tongue before I claim it." - Doedre Darktongue
"Virtue gems have facets beyond those that can be seen by the mortal eye. Let us look deeper..."

The suit I wear,
Is heavy and bare.
A canvas, it seems, breathing life into dreams.
Good and Evil can be woven together to become something greater than either.
Moribund, he gazed upon the journey taken as blood trickled down his chin. His eye closed on the city ahead that he would never call home.
Even the brightest eventually fade to darkness.
Taste and grow strong. Drink too much and be buried.
"I gave up my body for you. I gave up my name for you. And one day I shall give up my life for you."

Embrace horror.
Bathe in its beauty.

True to his title,
Voll, newly crowned,
had many of the
Eternal Empire's signature
extravagances destroyed.
The house always wins.
The sun shines not for me. I walk in darkness, never free. Time stopped when you both died in my arms.

To my number one fan.
- Griffin, with love
When you strive to write your name on the dense pages of History, someone else, inevitably, must be crossed out.

Separate, stories untold.
Together, memories unfold.
The Atlas is our prison, and our only defence. She is our only hope, and our certain doom.

Some people act as beacons, illuminating the path for others. I was lucky to meet one such person.
- Anton to Zhenya
Everything is not enough.
Some things should not be used. Some power is too great a risk.

"Set your life on fire.
Seek those who
fan your flames"
-Rumi of the Vaal
For centuries, they stood vigil in secret over their sleeping goddess, even as contamination oozed out of the decadent Vaal empire.
Why not both?

When you can only have one, which shall it be?
Red?
Blue?
Probably Green.
"I swore to use my position to help the people. What good is power when it just accumulates on the already-powerful?" - Erasmus, Imperial Gemcutter
The Golden Sekhema's words could solve many a feud. Just what form that solution took was another matter.

Our Lady Dialla,
as a symbol of our progress,
shines greater than all the gems.
When you dwell in total darkness, even the faintest light may guide you out.
The dead tell me great insights. They've had nothing but time to sit and think.
To accept a challenge from the void is merely suicide for the unprepared.

Shrieking souls locked away
Hate splits frozen cells asunder
The knot of corruption
undone at last

In the dead of night you may elude your shadows,
but they will always find you by dawn.

To her beauty you submit,
lest your neck the great Queen slit.

Black and White, Silver and Gold
Let us see the world Unfold
Red and Blue, Yellow and Green
Let us remake it in colours Unseen

The future is oft-foretold
in records of the past.

There are countless people,
countless stories,
and countless eras,
but there is one place that,
for a time, each of us loved
and was loved. It matters.
We matter.
The others succumbed to madness and depravity, but Lori fought on. Alone in the darkness, she could still see the dull light of hope's distant dawn.
What do you see in the mirror?

"This one? It is NOT for sale. You would sooner pry it from my lifeless hand."
- Jonfé Darontos, Ringmaker

Primed, curved and sleek.
Decisive and final.
For malice and righteousness.
There's but one solution.
To tame a beast, you first must subdue its heart.

"Where does the light go
when it is dark?"
The threads of fate are the strongest ties.
Everything is eroded by time, but sometimes the edges that fade can make a wonderful memory even more beautiful.
A life lost, A legacy born.

Turn the crank,
close your eyes,
and pray to the gods
for a pleasant surprise.
He was seeking sanity, but the demons were inside his head.

"Everything I have done has been for Wraeclast. You would pledge your life to me if you saw things my way... and soon, you will."
- High Templar Venarius

With great power comes...
...Even greater power.

r: Corrupted Blood cannot be inflicted on you
cards.f: Without the ability to weep, the heart hardens against both the pure and the corrupt.

They fought the storm together as one,
Until the longest of days was done.
Their love grew stronger
with every breath,
Until it was broken apart in death.
As their civilisation crumbled, the Vaal looked to their queen. In her, they saw a way out. In them, she saw a burden she was happy to free herself from.

Return with your shield...
or on it.

Many strive for greatness,
but it is challenge, unforeseen,
that forges heroes.
My memories tortured me without end. To escape them, I embraced nothingness, but oblivion simply brought a different kind of pain...

Time and change
shall naught avail,
To dim the Light
of Truth's fair grail.

Never dying, yet not living,
Endlessly they wander
beneath the harvest moon.

A true warrior fights
for those who cannot
fight for themselves.

"There are worlds that lie beyond the edge of my page, the edge of my understanding. Worlds of wonder. Worlds of terror."
Aramil - Cartographer to Emperor Chitus

"I know one lady for whose sake I will rip out my heart"
- Derrok, the Dreamer

Bound by fate,
inseparable by choice.

They can't be THAT lucky,
or they'd still be here!

Discipline forged our unbreakable Rampart.
Bastion against Despair.
Luck is a fool's game, and I know plenty of rich fools.
When the outcome is the same, does it matter if it is fortune or trickery?

Plenty enter, dreaming of treasure
Twenty bled, slain as they fled
Shadows loom, half left doomed
The blind cries, five lost eyes
Careless twins, a lich's new prize
One as a decoy, none pass the king
Gehennix feeds only on whispers

So many memories,
so much pain in
such a small token.
Drown it in blood
so you can forget.
Wraeclast will unite. This shall be my great work - the minds of the people made one.
A stereotypical joke may lead to an unexpected bond.

I cannot contain myself,
but I can barely squeak,
so many words I'd have for you,
if I could only speak!
Rigwald believed he'd seized great power, but it was the great power that had seized Rigwald

"Through thick and thin,
blood and bone,
a peaceful life
is one I can't condone."
- Tukohama, Father Of War
The mind had much to endure before the advent of thaumaturgy.

He wandered the bone-filled depths hoping each corner would be his last.
Eventually, he found Light.
Those whose hands are their livelihood know the importance of keeping them safe and warm.

"You cannot portray the world using just one colour. Together, you and I, we will paint our world into perfection."
- Kyra, renegade thaumaturgist
Greed is a hunger that only grows as you feed it
There is no mistake so great that it cannot be undone.

Every skull was once a person.
Though 'Who?' is rarely asked.
Friends, who wear
the crown of Nook,
Never need to ask.
They remember.

You want to know how
I haven't been caught?
It's not just speed.
You need some luck.

The prize vanished.
No trail, no struggle.
Just a single, rust-red hair.
Feeding on death, they grew stronger and stronger, until they were ready to hatch...
Savour these moments, for they may never return.

The unknowledgable know not
what treasures lie so closely
within their feeble reach.
There are countless worlds, but only those with limitless potential will be able to achieve perfection.
Even our most devout beliefs are subtly shaped by our darkest desires.
One who is blinded by their past may only see a sliver of the present.

As Kaom slew the last of his kin,
something deep inside him broke.
And through the cracks, corruption,
pure and black, spread forth.

Upon silent paws and masked by the reeds,
Farrul's hunt begins as the light recedes.
It is a mortal man's folly to seek power beyond his comprehension.
Accumulating wealth has its own costs.

Fire filled the sky that night
Chaos reigned
Where the shards fell
All was destroyed
-Jozen Kasigi, retelling an urban legend of the Cataclysm
Be like water, friend.
Whoever said 'more is always better' has obviously never met a rat.

He shattered Her smile
Scattered the fragments like ash
All she did was laugh
Life has an end, then life begins again.
Why settle when more is never enough.

He thought she was all
he ever wanted,
yet his heart yearned
for something more.

"For all your struggles, all your achievements, even for the greatest of us, a story is all that remains. Write it well."
-Julius Perandus, Father of Chitus

If you believe hard enough,
you'll win.

He dispels dark realms
until mortal sufferings
yield to hopeful light.

No blade conquers sin;
guide a sinner to virtue,
unveil their lost sight—
your eyes, too, see in
everyone the inner child,
no matter their might.
I've never come upon a ship I could not command. I have however met sailors that were not willing to be led.
If enough people believe something to be true, whether or not it is becomes irrelevant.

Their whims left unknown,
Their life left for others.

Cry havoc!
Unleash pandemonium!

We live to dream of worlds we aren't in,
a false narrative that we use to fill our souls
with doubt;
The world is already beautiful,
there's no need to dream.
Even in darkness you may find a friend.
Weapons such as these require a darker kind of forge...
"Our rulers are being ridiculous, and we are suffering."

'Lightning never strikes the same place twice'
is really just wishful thinking.
Blessed is the blood of the beholden disciple. The earth is anointed by his step. The damnable are sanctified by his strike.

Good things come
to those who wait;
but, greatness seeks
those who do not come.
They said they were here to protect us.

"Such dedication for so many years,
all for a couple extra letters at the front of your name..."
Lucian lost himself in ancient scrolls and found in those scrolls a love whose power bridged a millennium.
Dost thou lead my men to victory, my child?

"Some see our mortal flesh as a limitation. I see it as an opportunity for vast, miraculous improvements."
- Shavronne of Umbra
"You seek the power of my strongest potions, but the price will be far higher than you can imagine."
"When grasped in his hand, even an ordinary piece of wood can make the heavens tremble with fear."
The fight is the easy part. It's the years of training that'll kill you.

I gave my mind without a fight,
The twelfth hour I lost control.
The day is gone but there is light,
eyes that glow like red-hot coal.
"Paint, metal, flesh... A true artist does not limit himself." - Malachai the Soulless

Those Exiles that survive Wraeclast
dream not of home, but of power.

They would say that he was a dangerous man,
unbound by the sense of morality,
but what does this matter,
when his love for humanity is undeniable
and completion of his work would benefit everyone?

Justice comes swift
Equal to the crime
Revenge is a gift
Life for a life
Eye for an eye
Some seek to change the world. Others change the world as a consequence of what they seek.
In the pursuit of power, as in that of wealth, anything goes.
"No man can best me, no demon can fell me. For I vanquish all with my axe!"

For the blessed bear in the cave,
A hundred days pass in silence and darkness,
until moon begins its fourth passage,
the bear sheds her beastly fur,
and is reborn, human and whole.
To know the monster, you must become the monster.
It's sad times we live in when a friendship has a price people are willing to pay.
The pain you feel is of no consequence, it is evolution, to be made whole within something greater.
Lethal, untouchable, keen, aflame. Just what I was looking for.
While the Labyrinth traps have claimed countless adventurers, they were not designed with felines in mind.
They say it is the head that leads, but all must flow through the body at some point.
The flesh is a prison, and we are finally free.
A humble piece of wood offers the simplest solution to life's problems: just hit them really, really hard.
Ever get the feeling you're being watched...?

"When Voll spared Malachai, accepting his aid in pursuit of Purity, the strongest faith was infected by Corruption and made brittle as glass."
- Victario, the People's Poet

Vintage or crafted, Glittering and shiny
Dusty or glittering, huge or tiny
Secured within a chest
or unearthed from your mining
Find jewellery everywhere,
no need for divining!
So why is it so hard
to figure out which one to wear?
This one makes me stronger,
but does it match my hair?
Nothing can be heard above the din or seen amongst the turmoil. The senses are shattered. All is left to fate.
Blood flows not just through veins, but through worlds.
"The house always wins... except when I do."

From death, life.
From life, death.
The wheel turns,
and the corbies wheel overhead.

My son, you lost your way before you arrived.
To never lose you again,
I make a path in my heart.
The mighty warriors traded in blows, the nimble archers in arrows, yet it was the brazen thaumaturgists who would bring catastrophe to all.
Simple actions can lead the world to an early grave.
The largest hooks offer the greatest catch, but often the catch is the hook.
Wrapped in the glory of the heavens, she comes to mete out justice for the fallen.
Stare into its depths too long, and you may lose yourself entirely.
Scarier than any criminal is an innocent man in chains, for when he breaks free, his revenge will be justified.
Sometimes the best way to achieve greatness is to use a shortcut.
They whose lives were given to clothe the Dark Dreamer... They were the lucky ones.
No man may hope to turn back the storm. You can only hope you do not attract its ire.
The path to godhood is guided by the hand of sacrifice.
What was once a passing thought tickling the back of the mind is now a desperate, driving desire.

The First Ones
may be blasphemy,
but they are
powerful blasphemy.

Souls along a conduit of blood,
from one vessel to the next.
"Many believe murder is a grisly, grim, and grotesque crime. Then there are those who simply make art of it."

With staff in hand
and wrath in heart,
your soul and corpse
shall surely part.
A dream from which you cannot awake is nothing other than a nightmare.
In the pursuit of wealth, as in that of power, anything goes.
Beware the combatant who shows no confidence, yet still enters the ring, for they are surely hiding something.
"The Seas Call, the Mad Answer"
A man who hears voices may not necessarily be crazy.
Wherever she went, death was sure to follow.
You may be nothing to everybody, but you are everything to somebody.
Only a fool tries to contain unlimited power.
"They said I needed my head examined, but I'd rather just take yours." - Klopek the Cannibal
Upon seeing her face, I am terrified—the moon shows me my own form!

Scaly beast of the skies,
watching with his golden eyes.
Shadow that blocks out the sun,
it's too late for you to run.
They say when a dragon dies, the flesh smoulders and burns until all that remains is the still, white-hot, heart.

A dark note drips
from the dreamer's lips,
A honeyed melody.
We stand, we fall
on his beck and call,
for in his dream we're free.
All dreams vanish when the dreamers wake.
The finer the brew, the harder it is to remember drinking it.
"So desperate was I for control, I turned my entire world into a prison. Now you will share in my agony."

"I'm going for a walk. I'll be back soon."
- Blonca's last words
Time dismantles all things eventually, but some wish to accelerate the process.
He appeared before the Light Eater, and at once knew his soul was damned.
No matter where your dreams take you, Nightmare follows close behind.
Gaze towards the stars, but beware what gazes back.

Crimson rubies, drops of vigour,
flowing through my veins,
flesh like coal, try to crush me,
diamond is what remains.

r: Spiked Gloves of the Conquest (Culling Strike)
cards.f:
"Boss said to get rid of him, didn't say not to make a mess."
- Rune The Goon

Weaving the six,
a serpent stands tall.
Wearing a crown,
the thousand petals call.

"Glimmers of benevolence,
Shrouded a lacquered lust for power,
Yet still they followed his influence."
In fleeing reality, you step into the realm of madness.
They believed, falsely, that the strongest of generals could outlast eons of corruption.

"Long ago, people looked to the stars, believing they influenced us. Soon, it will be us who influence the stars."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturge

The Atlas invites us all
to a lifelong journey.
It would be unwise
to overstay our welcome.
A map is only useful if you know where you stand.
The Lord of Chaos dreams as his Eye gazes, unblinking, at his prize. And soon, all shall tremble before his waking form.

Some powers are far too great even for the
gods of old.
Fall into endless night; a voyage into an ocean of oblivion.
Shame what happened to my husband. He had such good taste.

Your era is now,
your power unwavered,
soon we will see
who the gods truly favoured.
A little extra flair never hurts.
However vicious Rhoas might be, a dedicated angler may in time tame them.
Let these fine arrows pack a punch.

Sturdy and strong,
grown from the stream.
The Flora that live here,
A combatant's dream.
Even the most learned man is a fool to his own fate.

It's about working smarter,
not harder.
Don't let fool's gold deceive you.

Formless might,
Wild beauty tamed,
The brine of gods,
The seas restrained.
You gave us life and love, more than you could spare. Now you're gone, and we are stranded, alone, cold and without purpose.

The fortunate find
generosity in the divine.
"When they realize our true intent, they will decry us, assault us, and try to crush what we have built. We must stand tall, Qotra, and make the future our own."

"Masters of wit, strength and cunning. To survive the harsh winters, you must be like the fox."
- Ezomyte Proverb
Hemmingsworth 6:10 - "And the fox gazed out from the brambles, unreachable and smirking."
"I don't believe in karma. If it were real, I would never win."
Maligaro may have valued function over form, but that did not mute his flair for the dramatic.
In the hands of a master craftsman, a worthless pebble can adorn the crown of a king.
"Axes and mauls are so uncivilised. A good clean cut to the neck with a sharp blade, that's the Sarn way!"

The thumb turns down
and the crowd roars,
they want death
and the blood is yours.
Before gemlings, before thaumaturgy, a simple court magician could enthrall the masses.
Chasing purity in the rising light means facing the darkening edges of the spirit.

I thought love stronger than all,
but time and isolation broke
that which madness could not.
Though the years weakened his mind, his body remained deadly as ever.

Taste not of their
forbidden fruit.
Theirs is a harvest of
the darkest kind,
twisted, rotten and
damned for eternity.
The hermit's only friend is the greenery he can find.
Try a thousand times, and eventually you'll have to give up.
Within years of knowledge, distilled by careful craftsmanship, lies great power.
"More! I want more!" - Faendris, the Insatiable
Every obsession began with a single, innocent taste.

"How many lives have you consumed?"
"How many times have you blinked?"

"Greetings! Just because you think I'm greedy doesn't mean I'm not willing to share. You'll just have to kill me first."
-Grandmaster Dy'Ness
When there is no other choice, even the meekest whisper can bring about the greatest storm.
His brother would not atone, so he took his brother's life, and with it, his sins.
Chaos spread, wreaking havoc and death. They said none would be spared, and yet here I stand.
One person's madness is another person's reality.
A lust for souls. The urge to kill just to satisfy its thirst. An unbearable burden that would make even the purest heart blacken over time.

Jump right in,
But beware
Of things broken
Or beyond compare.

Summoned for the King's desire,
soon applause came from the court.
However insanity was his only sire,
so the King's reign was cut short.
The jeweller's true talent is the capacity to see a jewel's beauty before they draw it out.
A good spy doesn't forget she's gone undercover.
Oh the places you will go, the sights you will see, the things you will meet.

"To know for what you fight. To get up again when you've been struck down. To outmanoeuvre someone faster, trick someone smarter, crush someone stronger. That's what it takes to claim the crown."
- Daresso, the King of Swords
500 times Kaom's axe fell, 500 times Kaom's Heart splintered. Finally, all that remained was a terrible, heartless Fury.

Gaze upon the Lake
Gaze upon your Reflection
Your full Potential
Warriors of a distant land, you embark on a journey from which you may not return, but which we will be all the better for.

Holding fast when shadows fall,
Over ruins, jesters call.
Nothing breaks their twisted cheer,
Kings of chaos, friends sincere.
The strongest emerge from suffering. The toughest bear the most scars. The sole survivor claims the greatest of rewards.
"Bino's brief career as a chef at Axiom saved the executioner a lot of work."

Ancient behemoths swam the
depths of the oceans long
before Man walked these lands.
When the dead raise and master their own, the land is truly lost.

"The process of eternal youth is a give and take. You give them death and take their youth."
- Zerphi of the Vaal
The Eternals lauded his valour. The Karui relished his defeat. Yet the final thoughts of Marceus Lioneye were naught but lament for his pride.

"This was the proudest moment of my life."
"... so far"
The rain pelts down, Mud grasping at his feet, as thoughts of those in his care bolster his resolve.

Thy knee shall bend
in shifting dark,
thy blade shall serve his vigil.
Thy oath shall bind thee
to his mark,
thy flesh shall bear his sigil.
Though they were a pack of elite combatants, the Emperor's royal guards were not ready to face one of his notorious parties.

"I wanted to give you three things. I've given you my eternal love. I've sung to you my most beautiful song. I'd have given you the moon last, but it couldn't be found. I hope you'll accept this instead."

Embrace the Light,
Await the Morrow,
No more Spite,
